value.rationale: Density seven is the first concrete cardinality enumerator missing from the published density-zero-through-six fixed-weight prefix-normal table, despite general fixed-weight rationality being known. The exact rational function resolves all lengths and yields an asymptotically sharp fixed-density probability; reaching it requires a nontrivial five-dimensional integer-cone decomposition with nonunimodular cells. This addresses a documented natural gap in a string-combinatorics invariant used in jumbled pattern matching, not a routine reparameterization.
